task.title: Complete provider-tool task turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/574 by preserving caller-owned completion intent across bounded provider/tool task turns and committing final provider content as both Attempt evidence and task output.
acceptance_criteria: Expose completion-specific initial and continuation operations that cannot lose terminal intent through generic continuations.
Keep each tool response non-terminal and require explicit caller-controlled progression with fresh identity and authorization.
On a final response, persist assistant content, an exact Attempt, and task completion with the same validated output in order.
Document and test durable projections, ordered partial commits, races, and multi-tool completion behavior.

attempts.summary: Established RED for initial and continued completion turns.
attempts.diagnostic: ToolAssistantRuntime had attempt-only task turns but no completion outcome, operation, or terminal-intent-preserving continuation.
attempts.patch: Added focused failing tests for final completion, completion after a tool step, and completion after multiple explicit tool steps.

attempts.diagnostic: Dedicated completion outcomes retain completion intent while reusing the bounded attempt-only provider/tool path; finalization appends the provider response as Attempt evidence and output-bearing completion.
attempts.patch: Added completion-specific outcomes and continuations, initial and continuation operations, integration coverage, and runtime documentation.

attempts.summary: Strengthened persistence assertions from substantive review.
attempts.diagnostic: Review found that returned completion projections were checked without consistently proving reopened session and task state on every final and continuation path.
attempts.patch: Reloaded and compared durable session and completed task projections in all three completion paths, including both continuation cases.

attempts.summary: Verified exact head and merged after review cooldowns.
attempts.diagnostic: Pinned verification and independent review passed. Rust quality gate run 30146004486 succeeded, and substantive CodeRabbit review completed for exact head with zero unresolved threads after false-green rate-limited attempts.
attempts.patch: Pull request 575 squash-merged as 3057a33da9740ee24ad66648e594f99345a21ef8 and closed issue 574.

outcome.summary: Provider-tool task turns can now retain caller-owned completion intent across explicit tool steps and durably complete with final provider content as both Attempt evidence and task output.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test tool_task_runtime # focused completion tests passed
Independent pre-commit review # no final actionable findings
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30146004486 and substantive CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/575

lessons: Terminal intent belongs in a dedicated continuation type so generic attempt progression cannot silently discard completion semantics.
Final provider text can serve as both Attempt evidence and completion output only after each domain value validates independently.
Returned projections do not replace reopen assertions when the contract promises durable state.
Rate-limited green review statuses must remain merge blockers until an exact-head substantive review finishes.
